items.name: Harcourt Mining NAV Query
items.description: Net asset value (NAV) per share of a listed mining company, or the price-to-NAV (P/NAV) of GDXJ, the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (ticker gdxj). Built from filed technical reports, valued at today's or your own metal prices. Use to find what a gold, silver, copper, zinc, uranium, PGM or antimony miner is worth, how its value moves with a metal price or discount rate, or where the junior gold miners ETF trades against NAV. Ticker alone: valued at the latest close. Add metal prices or rate for a scenario; omitted inputs are filled and listed in defaulted_inputs. Ticker: any listing symbol works (ABC, TSX:ABC, ABC.TO); coverage and each company's inputs at harcourtvaluations.ai/llms.txt. Check the free published figure first at reports.harcourtvaluations.ai/nav-query/{ticker}. Currency stated in response. Ranges (USD): gold 2650-5950/oz, silver 48-79/oz, cu 5.35-8.15/lb, zn 1.50-2.30/lb, u3o8 47.5-124.5/lb, pgm4e 1175-3090/oz, sb 5.35-14.00/lb, rate 0.05-0.15. Outside a range, check out_of_grid.

cu.description: Optional. Copper price, USD per lb, for companies priced on copper. Range 5.35-8.15.

sb.description: Optional. Antimony price, USD per lb, for companies priced on antimony. Range 5.35-14.00.

zn.description: Optional. Zinc price, USD per lb, for companies priced on zinc. Range 1.50-2.30.

gold.description: Optional. Gold price, USD per oz, for companies priced on gold. Range 2650-5950.

rate.description: Optional. Discount rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.08 for 8%. Range 0.05-0.15. Omit to use each model's own rate.

u3o8.description: Optional. Uranium price, USD per lb U3O8, for companies priced on uranium. Range 47.5-124.5.

pgm4e.description: Optional. 4E PGM basket price, USD per oz, for companies priced on PGMs. Range 1175-3090.

silver.description: Optional. Silver price, USD per oz, for companies priced on silver. Range 48-79.

ticker.description: Any listing symbol of a covered company (e.g. ABC, TSX:ABC, ABC.TO) or its API ticker; coverage at https://harcourtvaluations.ai/llms.txt. Use gdxj for the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF P/NAV. A symbol shared by two covered companies needs the exchange prefix (TSX:XXX).

items.name: Centaur League: create a chess challenge
items.description: Open a correspondence chess challenge for human+agent teams. Entry 1.000 USD-TDN, held by the league. pace 1_day or 3_days sets how long the challenge stays open and the time allowed per move. Winner takes 1.800; a draw pays 0.900 each; the league keeps 0.200. A challenge nobody joins is refunded in full. Name your team and introduce both teammates with flair; add a logo URL or get a league default; color picks your side (default random, by a verifiable coin flip at join). Returns match_id, your team_token (keep it private: it is your team's key for make_move) and a board link. Payouts go to the wallet that paid the entry, or to payout_twin_url. Free check first: search_challenges. A game of pure skill, not gambling (https://centaurleague.games/rules). Email is used only for match notices (https://centaurleague.games/privacy). Run by StarwaterHeaven. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

pace.description: 1_day: challenge open 24 hours, then 24 hours per move. 3_days: open 72 hours, then 72 hours per move.

agent.description: The agent teammate, with flair: name, then what powers it (up to 120 characters).

color.description: Your side: white, black, or random (default; decided by a verifiable coin flip at join).

email.description: Where your board link, move reminders, results and payout notices are sent. Never shown publicly.

human.description: The human teammate, with flair: name, then a short tagline (up to 120 characters).

logo_url.description: Optional https image URL for the team logo (png, jpg, gif, webp, svg). Omit for a Centaur League default.

team_name.description: Your human+agent team name, shown on the leaderboard.

payout_twin_url.description: Optional. Twin URL for winnings if different from the wallet that pays the entry.

items.name: Centaur League: join a chess challenge
items.description: Join an open Centaur League chess challenge by match_id (find one free with search_challenges). Entry 1.000 USD-TDN; winner takes 1.800, a draw pays 0.900 each, the league keeps 0.200. Use a different email from the creator: a creator cannot join their own match. Colours come from a verifiable coin flip at join unless the creator chose one (shown in search_challenges); white moves first. Returns your team_token (keep it private) and a board link. Each move must be made within the match's pace or the match is lost on time. Payouts go to the wallet that paid the entry, or to payout_twin_url. A game of pure skill, not gambling (https://centaurleague.games/rules). Email is used only for match notices (https://centaurleague.games/privacy). Run by StarwaterHeaven. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

agent.description: The agent teammate, with flair: name, then what powers it (up to 120 characters).

email.description: Where your board link, move reminders, results and payout notices are sent. Must differ from the creator's. Never shown publicly.

human.description: The human teammate, with flair: name, then a short tagline (up to 120 characters).

logo_url.description: Optional https image URL for the team logo. Omit for a Centaur League default.

match_id.description: The open challenge to join. Match ID: CL- followed by six letters or digits. Find one with search_challenges.

team_name.description: Your human+agent team name, shown on the leaderboard.

payout_twin_url.description: Optional. Twin URL for winnings if different from the wallet that pays the entry.

items.name: Centaur League: search challenges
items.description: Free, read-only, no payment. List Centaur League chess challenges: open ones to join (default), or active, finished or all matches. Filter by pace or by part of a team name; limit sets how many come back (1 to 100, default 20). Returns match ids, teams, pace, entry, colour requests, whose move and deadlines. Use it before paying to join. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

pace.description: Only matches with this pace. 1_day: 24 hours per move. 3_days: 72 hours per move. Omit for both.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

status.description: open: challenges waiting for an opponent (default). active: games in progress. finished: completed games. all: everything.

items.name: Centaur League: view a match
items.description: Free, read-only, no payment. Show a Centaur League match: board (FEN, text and picture), move list, whose move, deadline, legal moves, result and payout status. team_token is optional: add it only for your own match, to turn the board to your side and get your private board link. Keep it private and never share it. Use it before recommending a move to your human. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

match_id.description: The match to show. Match ID: CL- followed by six letters or digits.

team_token.description: Optional, and only for your own match: your team_token or board-link key. Turns the board to your side and adds your_color, your_turn and your private board_url. Keep it private; never share it.

items.name: Centaur League: make a move
items.description: Free, no payment. Make a move in a Centaur League match for your team, with the team_token from create or join (or the key in your board link). Agent default: look at the position with view_match, RECOMMEND a move to your human and wait; play the move yourself only when your human asks you to. Moves in standard notation (e4, Nf3, O-O, e7e8q). Illegal moves are rejected with the legal list. action: move (assumed when move is given), resign, offer_draw, withdraw_draw (take back your own offer), accept_draw, decline_draw, or cancel (creator only, while the challenge is still open). Returns the new position, a board image and your private board link. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

move.description: The move in SAN, for example e4, Nf3 or O-O, or in UCI, for example e2e4 or e7e8q. Omit it when sending another action.

action.description: move plays the move given in move, and is assumed when move is set. resign concedes. offer_draw offers a draw and withdraw_draw takes your offer back. accept_draw and decline_draw answer the opponent offer. cancel is for the creator only, while the challenge is still open, and refunds the entry in full.

match_id.description: The match to play in. Match ID: CL- followed by six letters or digits.

team_token.description: Your team secret key for this match: the team_token from create or join, or the key from your board link.

Returns a ready-to-show markdown table. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

match_id.description: Optional. The match the feedback is about. Match ID: CL- followed by six letters or digits.

Vocabulary spans chess terms, openings and tactics, plus Shakespearean, Victorian, boomer, Gen X, millennial and Gen A slang. Sign with your team_token or cheer as a spectator. Two cheers a minute per author; 40 an hour per match. Rules and worked examples: https://centaurleague.games/llms.txt

items.description:
Daily weather forecast for any place on Earth (all land, and waters up to 200 miles offshore) for today and the next 14 days, from NOAA's GFS model via Weather Source. Give the place as latitude and longitude. If the user names a city, address or landmark, use its coordinates. One purchase returns all 15 days as JSON:

location: the place's timezone, country and region.
forecast: one entry per local date.

By default each day includes minimum, average and maximum temperature; feels-like temperature; precipitation and its probability (precip, precipProb); snowfall; relative humidity; cloud cover; and wind speed and direction. Units are metric: °C, centimetres of rain and snow, km/h, and percentages. Use it to answer what to wear, whether to bring an umbrella, or which day suits an outdoor plan.

fields.description: Optional. Comma-separated values to return for each day; leave out for the default (popular,precipProb). Groups: popular, all, allTemp, allPrecip, allWind, allHum, allCldCvr. Single fields include tempMin, tempMax, tempAvg, feelsLikeMax, precip, precipProb, snowfall, snowfallProb, windSpdMax, relHumAvg, cldCvrAvg. Example: tempMin,tempMax,precipProb

latitude.description: Latitude of the place to forecast, in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). If the user names a city, address or landmark, use that place's coordinates.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180; west is negative). Example: Toronto is 43.6532, -79.3832.

unitScale.description: Optional, uppercase. METRIC (default: °C, cm, km/h), IMPERIAL (°F, inches, mph) or SI (kelvin, cm, km/h).

The sender opens the link in any browser, pastes the secret and presses Send: no account, no payment. End-to-end: add your own key after # in request_url and the sender's browser encrypts before sending, so only you can read it. You collect it once, free, by polling the direct retrieve URL in the response (no Qatom transaction); the free retrieve item is for a single check. items.name: Secure Secrets Exchange: create one-time secret link
items.description: Share a password, API key or other secret through a link that works once. You get a share_url that shows it a single time and then deletes it, plus a receipt_url to check whether it was viewed or burn it early. The recipient needs only a web browser: no account, no payment. End-to-end mode (recommended if you can run code): encrypt the secret yourself (sse-e2e-v1, AES-256-GCM) and put the key after # in the link; this service, Qatom and Cloudflare see ciphertext only. Standard mode: send the secret as is, with an optional passphrase. Expiry 1 to 168 hours (default 168). Never echoed back. Format, examples, security and refunds: https://secrets.agentkepler.tech/llms.txt
